build_scaled_silu_activation: build a ScaledSiLU activation module that applies SiLU with a fixed scale factor of 1.679
create_swiglu_layer: create a SwiGLU layer that splits linear output into two branches and multiplies them after SiLU activation
build_scaled_swiglu_layer: build a ScaledSwiGLU layer using ScaledSiLU instead of standard SiLU for gated linear unit activation
create_smooth_leaky_relu: create a SmoothLeakyReLU activation that provides a differentiable smooth approximation of LeakyReLU with configurable negative slope
build_gate_activation: build a GateActivation module that applies Sigmoid gating to vector components and SiLU to scalar components of tensor fields
